Treasureee, oh treasureee~♪!\nMy luck is finally turning around...
Holy moly?!
No, no, no!\nI'm here for the treasure, not for a corpse...
Wait, can you not kill people as you like?
Oh?! You're not dead?\nPerfect then! There's something I wanna ask.\nIs there any treasure around here?
Hey, hey! There're more important things to ask,\naren't there? Like what happened to me, whether\nI'm okay or something like that!
Wait! That's my book!\nWhy is it with you?!\nTell me honestly, now, c'mon!!
I-I picked it up!\nThe hints of the treasure's location might be\nwritten in it, so I can't give it to you!
But, that's my book, give it back to me!\nI must have it back...!
Give it back to her.
No way, it's ours now.
Well, well, actually...\nI only need to know where the treasure is.
What treasure are you talking about?\nOther than a lake and my house, there's nothing\nin front, you know!
All right, fine. So this is your book.\nBut, I picked it up at the city square...
Wow wow wow, wait! What?! Wait a sec!
This is just not right!\nShouldn't you be stopping me at this point?
Hmm...seems like recently you've learnt what I\nlike and what I want...
Excuse me, how are you two related...?\nAlso, where did you pick up this book?
So this is your book.\nBut, I picked it up at the city square...
City square? Did you see any reindeer there?
S-sorry.\nMy name is Velly.
Since the city has been restored, I was planning\nto give out presents this time...But, the reindeer\nnever came, plus I lost my book...
Well, seems like you have your own reasons too...\nFine, I'll return the book to you.
R-really?!
However! We want you to tell us what you know in\nreturn!
O-oh, okay...\nWell, follow me to my house first then.
Huh, the reindeer didn't come to my house\neither...?
By the way, why did you collapse on the ground\nlike that?
Actually, I was planning to go around and\ndistribute the presents from the city square with\nthe reindeer...
So I went there, but it wasn't there either.\nI had no choice but to head back, but then I lost\nthe book...
That book is like a permit to enter this forest.\nWithout it, one would get lost in this forest.
I see, that's why you collapsed.\nI had no idea it's such an amazing book...
Yup! It's an important object that has been handed\ndown through generations.
Only my family and relatives that possess this\nbook or those allowed by the family can enter this\nforest freely!
And you just dropped it like that.
I-I told you it was an accident! By the way,\nyou didn't see the reindeer either?
We just came here too, so we're not very sure.\nBut, I don't think we've seen it so far.
It didn't come to my house or the city square...\nWe should be out of danger now after what the\nXmas Knights had done for us...
Or maybe it's taking its time and is still picking\nthe presents there?
Whoa, you mean there are so many presents to\nchoose from? Right, you mentioned about giving out\npresents, there must be a lot of stuff...
What? Don't get me wrong. I only wanna help\nbecause it looks like she's in trouble.
You're right. I'm curious about what happened to\nthe reindeer...I think it'd be better if I have\nyou guys come with me.
Why are you hiding?\nHurry up and show us where to go.
O-okay. This way...
Phew, we're here!
Well, let me go and prepare the presents.
I knew you would come...I've been expecting you.\nThis is the only way to get to Navida City, so all\nI need to do is wait here...
Who's that?! What's that creature?!
W-what do you mean?!\nWho else is here besides us?!
Who else?! You of course!
Hey, Velly. What's that thing?!
Really...it's Dunder.
Wasn't it you who kidnapped him?
What...? But he was already in the bag when it\nhappened...
What?
Why were you in the bag though?
Well, it's kinda embarrassing, but it's been a\nwhile since we handed out presents, so I slacked\noff a little.
I got in the bag to play...*ahem, I mean to make\nsure that it is strong enough, and then he just\ncaught me like that...
Whatever! Let's settle this once and for all!\nBeat me if you wanna go to Navida City!
I can use my full power here!\nBehold the true power of anti-Xmas energy!
Oh, c'mon! After all we still have to fight!\nHey, do your job!
We can only cheer for you! Good luck!
No matter how I look at it, you seem to be capable\nof doing more than that though...
I-it can't be helped!\nAnyway, go kick his ass!
I-I can't believe I lost again...
Now you know that's as far as you can go,\ndon't cha? So stop getting in the way!
Well, then let's go for the treasure...
Scuse me, Velly.\nWas it even you who defeated me?
What? You have a problem with that?\nIt was you who started picking fights first!
Uh...how about the treasure...
Uh...could you help me to prepare the presents?
Hmm...seems like it's gonna take a while.\nAll right, I'll help.
Getting help from outsiders like them is against\nthe rules, you know! If you need help, at least\nyou should just ask your people!
That means I can ask Dunder, right?!
Why did you have to mention that creature's name!\nDon't you have a decent friend?!
Huh, huh...Anyway, you stay out of this!\nI'll do it my way this time.
I-I'll let you do what you want this time...\nBut next time, I definitely won't...
Well, my lady. Everything is ready.\nLet's go to distribute the presents!
Aight, let's go!
You just stay there and watch!
C'mon, Dunder!
I got this, my lady!
It was manual labor till the end.
Next time for sure...I won't let this happen.
Well, good luck...\nThat will certainly add the treasure's value.
What?
Pom?
Whoaa! Why are you here?!
Oh, right. I totally forgot about its existence.
